title: Ops Pulse — Operations Analytics Dashboards
summary: Decision-ready dashboards that make throughput, backlog, and service-level performance visible week to week.
problem: Operations leaders needed fast answers (what’s breaking, where we’re falling behind, what changed since last week), but reporting lived across spreadsheets and one-off pulls. Decisions were delayed and discussions were inconsistent.
approach: Defined a small, stable KPI set; mapped data sources; built a layout optimized for weekly review; and added clear definitions so metrics weren’t debated every meeting. Prioritized trust: consistency, refresh cadence, and explainability.
outcome: Created a single source of truth for weekly ops reviews and reduced manual reporting effort with shared metrics and definitions.
